title: PH pushes wider social security coverage for freelancers

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Social Security System (SSS) is partnering with the Department of Information and Communications Technology to expand social security coverage for an estimated 1.5 million freelancers and virtual assistants in the Philippines. The two agencies signed a memorandum of understanding on Oct. 21 to promote social security membership and compliance among workers in the online freelancing industry. READ: SSS to extend benefits to MMDA job order, contract workers SSS President and CEO Victor Alfonso Limlingan said the partnership would strengthen the online freelancing sector through skills training, competency development, and wider access to social security benefits.
